thread:
deploy-bot: Starting canary deploy r-20260316 to inference-service (canary 10%). Health check failures: KMS_DECRYPT_ERROR returned 403 from KMS service for key alias `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rw-ring/cryptoKeys/rnw-key-v3`. Auto-rollback scheduled in 4m.

jay (oncall): got page. paging nina and tom.

incident-bot: PAGER: @nina @jay @tom @leo 51 High error rate: inference canary 5xxs, error=KMS_DECRYPT. Link: /incidents/1990012345.

nina (sre): checking canary logs: repeating stack traces: `rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = requester's service account does not have cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter on rnw-key-v3` and `failed to initialize key decryptor`.

tom (prod-eng): we rotated to rnw-key-v3 in the rollout config. Looks like the new key's IAM policy doesn't include inference-prod SA. Maybe rotation was done before CI job that updated bindings.

jay (oncall): customer impact? which slice affected?

nina (sre): roughly 10% of inference traffic (the canary). Proxy shows elevated 502/504 responses for that slice. No broad outage.

leo (security): pulling KMS audit log now. I see a denied entry: logName="projects/redwood/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity" protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt" authInfo.principalEmail="service-account@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com" status.code=7

infra-sre: quick mitigation options: (A) stop canary traffic (set canary weight=0) (B) toggle feature flag to force use of fallback key path (C) add KMS decrypt role to SA. Fastest containment is A or B.

jay (oncall): prefer non-permission changes if possible. Can we flip a kill-switch flag to fallback to previous key? Which flag?

tom (prod-eng): flag name is `inference.kms_use_new_key`. Toggle via flags API or we have a helper: 
```
flagsctl deactivate inference.kms_use_new_key --env prod
```
I can run it if SRE gives go.

nina (sre): I'll drain canary first: `redwoodctl traffic set inference-service --canary 0`

deploy-bot: Traffic update: canary weight -> 0%. Stable serving receiving 100% traffic.

nina (sre): after drain, 5xx rate for customers returned to baseline. Canary pods still logging KMS failures but no customer impact. Keeping incident open.

tom (prod-eng): toggled flag `inference.kms_use_new_key` -> deactivated. That makes service fall back to `rnw-key-v2` via config shim.

leo (security): while that contains it, I'm going to patch IAM: add binding `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` to member `serviceAccount:inference-prod@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` on key `rnw-key-v3`. Command: 
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding rnw-key-v3 \
  --location global --keyring rw-ring \
  --member=\"serviceAccount:inference-prod@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com\" \
  --role=\"roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter\"
```
Applying now.

leo (security): binding applied and IAM policy change propagated. KMS audit shows successful Decrypt calls starting at 1990012655.

nina (sre): canary pods reattempted decrypts and now succeed. I see token generation succeed and 200s in logs.

tom (prod-eng): recommendation: re-run rollout with canary 5% and a short smoke window. We'll prefer toggling FF back on only after confirmation. Also add a pre-flight KMS permission check in the deployment pipeline.

jay (oncall): agreed. Nina, will you own next steps and follow-up items?

nina (sre): I'll own follow-up. Action items: 1) Add a deployment gate that validates KMS key IAM for all SAs referenced in deployment config. 2) Update runbook with feature-flag kill-switch commands and make sure SRE has emergency flag tokens. 3) Coordinate with security to add a CI job that ensures IAM bindings exist before key alias switches.

infra-sre: note for postmortem: consider making key rotation atomic with IAM binding update via a coordinated script to prevent races. Also surface KMS dependency in Helm charts so reviewers spot it.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by operator (manual). Canary remains drained.

incident-bot: Severity lowered to S2 after containment. Creating postmortem workspace: #pm-1990012345.

jay (oncall): I'll inform CSMs for affected customers with a short blurb; no data exposure, short service degradation limited to canary.

leo (security): adding a monitoring alert that flags KMS permission-denied spikes pre-rollout. Also adding a dashboard for key rotation safety checks.

nina (sre): timeline: 1990012345 alert created -> 1990012405 canary drained -> 1990012460 flag toggled -> 1990012550 IAM binding applied -> 1990012655 canary pods recover -> 1990012900 rollout paused for 30m smoke.

jay (oncall): handing off to infra-sre for overnight watch. I'll close my shift after handoff.

infra-sre: taking handoff. I'll monitor decrypt success rate and 5xxs for 2h. Will report back to nina.

incident-bot: Handoff recorded: from jay to infra-sre. Next update expected in 1h.

tom (prod-eng): follow-up: I'll add `scripts/check_kms_iam.sh` to the repo and wire it into CI gate. Also ensure feature flag toggles are scriptable by on-call team tokens.

nina (sre): drafting postmortem and will schedule a remediation review with security and platform next week.

jay (oncall): thanks team. keeping incident open until remediation tasks scheduled. :thumbsup:
